csv_project_name: Design for Cheesequake Park Campground Restroom Replace
csv_agency: State of NJ Div of Property Mgmt & Construction
csv_scope_of_work: The objective of this project is to demolish the existing facility and to design and construct a New Restroom/ Shower facility located at Cheesequake State Park in Middlesex County. The Consultant shall also have in-house capabilities or Sub-Consultants pre-qualified with DPMC in: P002 Electrical Engineering P003 HVAC Engineering P004 Plumbing Engineering P005 Civil Engineering P006 Sanitary Engineering P007 Structural Engineering P011 Environmental Engineering P025 Estimating/ Cost Analysis P037 Asbestos Design P038 Asbestos Safety Control Monitoring P065 Lead Paint Evaluation The Consultant shall provide the Design, Construction Administration, Permitting and Bid/Award Services for the demolition, removal, and complete replacement of the Family Campground Restroom/Shower building located at Cheesequake State Park using current codes and standards. The Consultant shall meet and coordinate with DEP and Park Staff to outline the functional requirements necessary for the new sanitary facility to be constructed on the existing footprint and location.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: Design for Cheesequake Park Campground Restroom Replacement
short_description: Design and replacement of a campground restroom and shower building in Cheesequake State Park.
project_location: Cheesequake State Park, Matawan, Middlesex County, New Jersey, USA
project_scope: Demolition of the existing family campground restroom/shower facility and design and construction of a new sanitary building on the existing footprint and location at Cheesequake State Park. The consultant is to coordinate with DEP and park staff to define functional requirements and deliver a complete replacement using current codes and standards.
services: Architectural design, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, environmental engineering, electrical engineering, structural engineering, HVAC engineering, plumbing engineering, sanitary engineering, estimating/cost analysis, value engineering, asbestos design, asbestos safety control monitoring, lead paint evaluation, permitting, bid/award services, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Small restroom/shower building replacement with limited structural ambition.
- Primarily a general building project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Structural engineering is included, but as one discipline among many for a conventional facility.
- Construction cost is modest, suggesting limited complexity and low strategic fit for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The documents indicate a full consultant scope including architecture, engineering, permitting, bid/award services, and construction administration for a $2.5 million building replacement.
references_qualifications: Only firms attending the mandatory pre-proposal meeting may submit. The consultant must have in-house capabilities or DPMC-prequalified subconsultants in Electrical (P002), HVAC (P003), Plumbing (P004), Civil (P005), Sanitary (P006), Structural (P007), Environmental (P011), Estimating/Cost Analysis (P025), Asbestos Design (P037), Asbestos Safety Control Monitoring (P038), and Lead Paint Evaluation (P065).
contracting_authority: State of New Jersey, Division of Property Management & Construction (DPMC), 33 West State Street, Trenton, NJ 08625, USA. Contact: Youstina Mansy. Email: youstina.mansy@treas.nj.gov. Phone: 609-633-2077. Website: https://www.nj.gov/treasury/dpmc/project_routine_advertisements.shtml
